categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the development, production, and sales of new bio-based materials using biomanufacturing technology. Its main products include bio-based long-chain dicarboxylic acids, bio-based pentamethylene diamine, and bio-based polyamides. The company also focuses on bio-based polyamide composite materials and their applications in textiles, engineering plastics, and large-scale scenarios such as new energy equipment and green building materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced synthetic biology, cell engineering, biochemical engineering, and polymer materials engineering technologies. It employs microbial metabolic pathway engineering, AI-assisted enzyme design, fermentation and biotransformation processes, and polymerization techniques to produce bio-based long-chain dicarboxylic acids, bio-based pentamethylene diamine, and bio-based polyamides. The production methods emphasize green, low-carbon, and sustainable biomanufacturing processes with proprietary patents and trade secrets.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic and international enterprises in industries such as textiles, automotive, electronics, green building, new energy, and logistics. The company serves downstream markets requiring bio-based polyamide fibers, engineering plastics, and composite materials. Major end markets include automotive parts, electronic and electrical components, industrial textiles, and environmentally friendly materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jining (Jinxiang), Wusu, and Taiyuan, and has sales and warehouse facilities in the United States and Europe to serve international customers. Its products are sold domestically and exported to regions including the US and the European Union.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, producing bio-based monomers such as long-chain dicarboxylic acids and pentamethylene diamine, as well as polyamides and composite materials. It controls core raw materials production and polymerization processes, supplying to downstream manufacturers and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding bio-based polyamide applications, developing green and sustainable bio-based monomers, and advancing biomanufacturing technologies. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI-assisted enzyme design, microbial strain improvement, fermentation optimization, polymerization process innovation, and composite material development. It also emphasizes agricultural waste valorization and building high-throughput synthetic biology platforms to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of bio-based chemical products including long-chain dicarboxylic acids, pentamethylene diamine, and polyamides. The company mainly uses a direct sales model to industrial customers, with some sales to non-end trade customers. It also earns income from technology licensing and strategic investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading global position in bio-based long-chain dicarboxylic acids and bio-based polyamides production. It competes with traditional chemical manufacturers like Invista, DuPont, BASF, Arkema, and Evonik, as well as emerging bio-based material producers. Its competitive advantages stem from proprietary biomanufacturing technology, integrated supply chain, and strategic partnerships with major downstream customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.11 billion, a 13.39% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 366.5 million, down 33.75%. The company maintains substantial assets totaling RMB 18.83 billion and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D. Despite short-term revenue decline due to market and macroeconomic factors, the company is expanding production capacity and advancing commercialization of new bio-based products.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its green, sustainable biomanufacturing process that uses renewable biomass as raw materials, significantly reducing carbon emissions compared to traditional petrochemical products. Its bio-based polyamides offer superior performance such as high strength, heat resistance, and recyclability, enabling applications in lightweight automotive parts and composite materials that replace steel and aluminum. The integrated supply chain, proprietary technology, and strategic collaborations provide cost competitiveness and product quality advantages.
